family_reports.body: Family court failed to protect me and my children, ignored the evidence, and allowed the abuse to continue. Civil court did not, when presented with the same facts, a jury held my ex‑husband and his wife liable for a long list of abuse.

The family court has stolen time with my kids memories I can never get back and made someone who worked hard play harder a prisoner not only in my mind but in everyday life. I find myself in my own my own prison not wanting to go anywhere or talk to anyone and can find days become night. Family court has broken me down where I have lost any hope that justice exists.

On false allegations with no evidence, I was reduced from full physical and legal custody to a 15 minute phone call once a month. I have never been adjudicated of doing any harm to anyone and never been allowed to defend myself after numerous false allegations.
I now have two emotionally damaged children and have been barred from helping them. If I had learned to lie, maybe I could have more than 15 minutes a month with my 14 year-old daughter.

public_comments.comment_text: As court commissioner removed all of Fathers visitation rights on a contested false ex parte order. As a judge, refused to self recuse on the ground with bias at the very first hearing in the case as a judge. The next hearing he almost completely removed all visitation rights of the father based on a nickname that the father had used with the minor all her life. This was contested an open court, and the hearing that was supposedly scheduled was denied outright by the judge’s own mouth saying “you never asked for a hearing“
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Refused to follow CCP 5.250 and when asked to provide “investigator” for questioning stated “I’m not going to do that to her” “you can appeal, you’ve done it before” also at first appearance was noted and called out for extreme bias and asked to recuse, refused without pause. Illegally used report to that was openly contested to further remove fathers contact. Allowed custody interference without action
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: This was my ex’s attorney’s last attempt to make my case go away. This judge only purposely was to act like he was having a hearing and then ignore any facts or evidence in the case and quickly gavel down and run away.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: So corrupt. Sides with dads. Blatantly says how he doesn’t follow the law. We don’t have him on record saying these things. He’s a nightmare.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent
